categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: non-ferrous metal materials (hazardous solid waste resource products), filtration materials, and environmental governance (flue gas treatment engineering and integrated urban-rural sanitation services). These segments encompass hazardous waste disposal, high-temperature filtration materials production, and environmental engineering projects including flue gas purification and sanitation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary core technologies developed through its national enterprise technology center and collaborations with universities. It specializes in high-performance high-temperature filtration materials with properties such as corrosion resistance and long service life. The company also develops integrated flue gas treatment systems and hazardous waste resource recovery technologies, employing advanced manufacturing and environmental engineering methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as power generation, cement, steel, waste incineration, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and urban sanitation sectors. The company serves both domestic and international industrial clients requiring environmental protection solutions, filtration materials, and hazardous waste treatment services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with significant business in regions including Fujian, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shaanxi, Hebei, and others. It also has international projects and exports, with overseas revenue accounting for approximately 8.35% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection and materials supply chain, producing filtration materials and providing environmental engineering services. It also engages in hazardous waste resource recovery, positioning itself as a comprehensive environmental solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening R&D in filtration materials, especially high-temperature and functional filters, advancing hazardous waste resource recovery technologies, and expanding environmental governance services. The company emphasizes innovation through its national technology center, partnerships with academic institutions, and continuous product and process upgrades to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of filtration materials, environmental engineering project contracts, hazardous waste resource product sales, and sanitation service contracts. The company also earns income from trade and investment disposals, with a focus on product sales and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in high-temperature filtration materials and environmental governance sectors, with a strong market position supported by proprietary technology and comprehensive service offerings. It competes with other environmental technology firms and filtration material manufacturers in China, leveraging its integrated business model and technical expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 466 million RMB, a 9.54% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 109 million RMB. The company experienced operational challenges due to capacity restrictions and goodwill impairment but continues to invest in R&D and strategic business expansion. It has a workforce of nearly 1,400 employees and maintains significant assets totaling around 792 million RMB.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value through advanced proprietary filtration materials with superior high-temperature and corrosion resistance, integrated environmental governance solutions, and hazardous waste resource recovery capabilities. Its comprehensive service chain, technological innovation, and compliance with stringent environmental standards differentiate it in the market, aiming to harmonize economic benefits with environmental protection.
